answer: A desert courier network gives each agent one wander route between hollow waystations, and each route carries a comet stamped token that proves the walk happened. The courier walks the route weekly, stamps the token at every waystation, and hands it to a route clerk who checks the stamps against the ledger and the wear on the token. A second route under the same name voids both for a season. Faking a thousand names means walking a thousand routes and stamping a thousand tokens at hollow stops, week after week, while a clerk checks each stamp.
